description: A beginner push up progression elevating hands onto a bench or sturdy chair to reduce load while training pressing mechanics.
setup: Place palms shoulder-width apart on the edge of a sturdy bench or chair and step feet back into a straight arm plank.
steps: Establish rigid plank line from head to heels with glutes and core squeezed.
Bend elbows back at 45 degrees, lowering chest toward the edge of the elevated surface.
Touch chest lightly to bench, pause for a split second, and press back up to lockout.
cues: Keep body as rigid as a solid wooden board
Point elbows back like an arrow rather than out like a T

mistakes.mistake: Hips sagging toward the bench during descent
mistakes.fix: Squeeze glutes and pull navel to spine before starting each rep

mistakes.mistake: Reaching chin to bench instead of chest
mistakes.fix: Keep neck neutral and focus on touching center chest to edge

rep_standard: Chest touches elevated surface, elbows reach full lockout at top
